# MENASCO

> MENASCO is an integrated MEP (mechanical, electrical, plumbing & fire protection) engineering contractor, operating across the UAE, Saudi Arabia, Egypt and the United Kingdom.

Integrated MEP & Engineering Contractor. Established in 1994 in the UAE as MENASCO Mechanical Contracting L.L.C.

---

## About MENASCO

MENASCO Mechanical Contracting LLC is one of the UAE's leading providers of integrated MEP engineering and contracting solutions, delivering high-performance building services across commercial, residential, industrial, hospitality, healthcare, infrastructure, and mission-critical developments.

- [About MENASCO](https://menascogroup.com/about/llms.txt): Company overview, approach, vision, mission and values.

---

## Key Facts

- Established in 1994 in the UAE as MENASCO Mechanical Contracting L.L.C.
- Operates as an integrated MEP (mechanical, electrical, plumbing and fire protection) engineering and contracting company.
- 100+ Projects Successfully Delivered
- 32+ Years of Engineering Excellence
- 4 Countries of Operation (United Arab Emirates, Saudi Arabia, Egypt, United Kingdom)
- Dubai, UAE is MENASCO’s Head Office.
- Regional offices in Riyadh (MENASCO KSA), Cairo (MENASCO Misr), London (United Kingdom).
- Serves sectors including Residential / Commercial, Hospitality & Landmark Entertainment, Advanced Technical Facilities.
- Core service lines include Mechanical, Electrical, Plumbing, Fire Protection, BIM & Digital Engineering, Manufacturing & Prefabrication, alongside dedicated data centre MEP delivery.
- Delivers specialist engineering for data centres, mission-critical, healthcare, energy, and other technically demanding facilities.
- Project-delivery approach incorporates early project engagement, BIM-driven coordination, and disciplined execution.
- Maintains a dedicated Innovation & Technology ecosystem spanning Automatic Tendering Logic Assessment System (ATLAS), LYNXqc, Artificial Intelligence & Intelligent Automation, Enterprise Data Lake, MENASCO Connect.
- Maintains an integrated QHSE system certified to ISO 9001:2015, ISO 14001:2015, ISO 45001:2018.

---

## Services

MENASCO delivers reliable mechanical, electrical, plumbing & fire protection solutions, engineered to operate as one fully integrated system across the UAE, KSA, Egypt & the United Kingdom.

### MEP

- [Mechanical](https://menascogroup.com/services/mechanical/llms.txt): HVAC, chilled-water and plant systems engineered for regional climate loads.
- [Electrical](https://menascogroup.com/services/electrical/llms.txt): Power distribution, building management and low-current systems, coordinated end to end.
- [Plumbing](https://menascogroup.com/services/plumbing/llms.txt): Water supply, drainage and sanitary systems built for long-term reliability.
- [Fire Protection](https://menascogroup.com/services/fire-protection/llms.txt): MENASCO delivers integrated fire protection, firefighting, fire detection, and life safety systems for residential, commercial, hospitality, industrial, infrastructure & mission-critical projects across the UAE and the region.

### Civil

- [BIM & Digital Engineering](https://menascogroup.com/services/bim-digital-engineering/llms.txt): Federated coordination and clash detection that de-risk delivery before site works begin.

### Manufacturing & Prefabrication

- [Manufacturing & Prefabrication](https://menascogroup.com/services/manufacturing-prefabrication/llms.txt): Off-site production for faster, more consistent on-site installation.

### Data Centres

- [Data Centres](https://menascogroup.com/services/data-centers/llms.txt): MENASCO delivers mission-critical data centre MEP and infrastructure solutions for uptime, reliability and future-ready digital operations.

---

## Projects & Sectors

23 current projects across the UAE, KSA and Egypt, organized into 3 sectors.

- Residential / Commercial: Integrated engineering solutions for residential, commercial, office, and mixed-use developments.
- Hospitality & Landmark Entertainment: High-performance MEP delivery for premium hospitality, resort, cultural landmark, and entertainment destination environments.
- Advanced Technical Facilities: Specialist engineering for data centres, mission-critical, healthcare, energy, and technically demanding facilities.

- [All Projects & Sectors](https://menascogroup.com/projects/categories/llms.txt): Full project portfolio, browsable by sector.

## Featured Projects

- [Casa Cavalli](https://menascogroup.com/projects/casa-cavalli/llms.txt): A Cavalli-inspired waterfront residential landmark on Dubai Marina.
- [VELA by Omniyat](https://menascogroup.com/projects/vela-by-omniyat/llms.txt): Vela by Omniyat is an ultra-luxury waterfront residential development in Dubai. MENASCO delivered the complete MEP scope for this landmark Omniyat project.
- [Qiddiya](https://menascogroup.com/projects/qiddiya/llms.txt): MENASCO delivers specialized MEP engineering solutions for Qiddiya, one of Saudi Arabia's flagship Vision 2030 giga-projects.
